ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S3 Learned Admission returns to the validated JS1.1S1 performance baseline for RimWorld 1.5 and replaces the rejected S2 unconditional fanout experiment with sampled query-shape learning. ThingRequest-backed JobGiver ClosestThingReachable searches with at least 256 candidates retain the validated S1 nearest-first validator-first/live-CanReach path. Smaller 16-255 ThingRequest and supported custom IList searches remain Vanilla by default; RimMT samples live Vanilla latency per query shape, admits only persistently slow shapes, periodically re-samples Vanilla, and automatically revokes/cools down shapes whose accelerated EMA no longer wins. Supplemental nearest-first ordering covers no-priority Global searches with 32-63 candidates while the existing >=64 path remains unchanged. JR1/JR1.1 and S2 fanout16 are not installed. ReachProfile keeps JS1.1R prediction/build behavior and the embedded rolling safety fuse.
